scope: Known capabilities and limits, with unresolved items explicit. Stock specifications are not proven silicon ceilings. No new device measurements.

entries.value: 1/2.3-inch CCD; approximately 16 million effective pixels
entries.constraint: Exact sensor part, readout modes and register contract remain unknown.
Largest documented still mode; RAW capture is not exposed in the documented stock file formats.

entries.value: 6x optical zoom; 4.6-27.6 mm; lens-shift VR
entries.constraint: Optical reach is physical. Focus and lens motion interfaces are not recovered as callable development APIs.
Official Japan page lists f/3.5-6.5; Canada lists f/3.3-6.5. Resolve against the unit/manual before treating either as authoritative.

entries.value: ND filter insertion, -3.3 AV
entries.constraint: Do not assume a continuously variable iris from an aperture menu label.

entries.value: About 1.3 fps, up to 6 full-resolution shots
entries.constraint: Documented mode performance; not a measured baseline for this unit or proof of maximum sensor/ISP throughput.

entries.value: 1280 x 720, 640 x 480 or 320 x 240 at 30 fps; AVI Motion-JPEG
entries.constraint: Neither higher resolution nor a new codec is established as feasible.

entries.value: 2 GB or 29 minutes per clip
entries.constraint: Stock recording/file policy, not an established immutable hardware ceiling.

entries.value: ISO 80-3200; ISO 3200 limited to 4M, 2M or VGA
entries.constraint: Raising a numeric limit does not establish usable sensor output or acceptable noise.

entries.value: 1/2000-1 s; 4 s in Fireworks mode
entries.constraint: Mechanical plus electronic shutter; longer or faster operation requires timing and calibration evidence.

entries.value: 2.7-inch TFT; about 230,000 dots
entries.constraint: Dots are not an established framebuffer pixel geometry, stride or format.

entries.value: About 42 MB internal image storage; SD/SDHC/SDXC
entries.constraint: Image storage is not RAM or total flash capacity. Vendor-tested card sizes are not a proven addressing maximum.

entries.value: Hi-Speed USB; MTP/PTP
entries.constraint: Protocol support does not establish sustained transfer speed, live view or a debug API.

entries.value: EN-EL19; approximately 210 shots under CIPA conditions
entries.constraint: Rating does not measure this aged battery, energy per algorithm or current runtime.

entries.value: 0-40 degrees C
entries.constraint: Documented operating environment; no thermal headroom measured for custom workloads.

entries.value: ELF32 little-endian MIPS; primary application indexed with MIPS32 listings
entries.constraint: Tiny loader has differing ISA flags. Library names do not establish actual CPU silicon or a complete target ABI.

entries.value: ThreadX, FileX and Zoran COACH identifiers
entries.constraint: Identifiers are firmware evidence; exact COACH generation, core count and hardware revision remain unconfirmed.
Getter0x80025198 reads56 runtime u32 values at0x808a5b8c; table contents are absent from the supplied file. Exact clock state, CPU/SoC model and active core count remain unconfirmed.
DRAM API0x8003c3ac reads register0xb8002010; selectors1..6 map to8..256MiB. The live selector and allocator headroom are unread, so installed RAM remains unknown.
Supplied update is not a whole-device dump. NAND monitor loop arithmetic does not establish capacity, ECC, bad-block handling or calibration coverage.

Shared seven-u32 descriptor geometry is recovered, with temporary scale allocation/wait/free. Packing, pitch, colour/address domains, complete lifetime/cache rules and active saved-JPEG integration remain unresolved.
Need sensor bit depth/readout contract, ISP command ownership and active capture path. Static gamma MMIO references alone do not establish a usable hardware API.
No measured startup, shot-to-shot latency, preview fps, CPU headroom or energy-per-shot baseline for this unit. Host timings are separate.

entries.value: Six u32 CPU-counter fields in a 24-byte buffer; nine profiling command records
entries.constraint: External transport and safe invocation are unverified. Do not expose arbitrary monitor strings or touch MMIO from the host.

Live descriptors match PTP mode 4 or 7; recovered debug path uses a different mode/registration. Independent debug entry, safe read bounds, full backup/write geometry and reset recovery remain unverified.
Setup/view blocks stage into store0x800032d4 and reach media transaction0x80009644. Physical write extents, checksum boundaries, atomicity, wear and complete runtime persistence remain unverified.

entries.value: 19,005,632 supplied bytes; 463 packed blocks; 7,950,592 decoded bytes
entries.constraint: All supplied bytes preserved. This does not include absent full-device flash, calibration or original source code.

entries.value: 368 files; 33 reversible string tables; 73 reversible indexed bitmaps; 5,798 function ranges
entries.constraint: Some fonts, palettes and resource consumers remain opaque. Function ranges do not recover names or complete semantics.

entries.value: 2,611,712 logical resource-volume bytes absent from supplied update
entries.constraint: All parsed live allocated files fit in the source. Missing logical tail is preserved as an absence, not fabricated.

entries.value: Hash-bound fixed-size FAT-resource and decoded virtual-span patches
entries.constraint: No relocation or growth. Missing entropy codes and packed-payload overflow can prevent an edit. Byte validation does not prove runtime correctness.

entries.value: Welcome studio label observed; subsequent USB inventory reports V1.1
entries.constraint: Observation applies to the prior label candidate. Restart, capture/playback and settings-persistence checks were not individually recorded.

entries.value: Original plus four RGB8 looks; 2,560 table bytes; row processing without heap allocation
entries.constraint: Real MIPS32r2/o32 build and 58 synthetic emulation cases now pass. It is not inserted into camera firmware; hook placement, buffer ownership and recovery remain unresolved.

entries.value: 960-byte legacy packed gamma format; GammaDDE associated with display path
entries.constraint: Not three ordinary RGB curves. Active saved-still selection and full converter behavior remain unresolved.

entries.value: Existing Color Options dispatch plus matrix/offset command 15 mapped
entries.constraint: Command 15 is now traced through cache, group 11, slot 15, factory 11 and matrix register upload. Complete buffer ownership and safe arbitrary integration remain unresolved.

entries.value: 24,210-byte 640 x 480 baseline JPEG replacement; user reports update completion and changed artwork
entries.constraint: Observation applies to the recorded Pocket Studio identity build. Repeated restart/capture/playback checks remain pending; resource dimensions do not establish framebuffer geometry.

entries.value: 4608 x 3456: RGB8 47,775,744 bytes; unpacked 16-bit 31,850,496 bytes; packed 12-bit 23,887,872 bytes
entries.constraint: Pure arithmetic excluding stride, alignment and scratch; not proof that any of these are the camera's buffer formats or available RAM.

entries.constraint: Checksum is sum of bytes0..0x19d modulo256 at+0x19f, excluding+0x19e. Physical storage bounds, failure handling and power-loss behavior remain unresolved.

entries.constraint: Static byte coverage is bounded and is not complete semantic recovery. Direct Ghidra now supplements REA workflow/inventory; the REA adapter remains unsupported for this target.

entries.constraint: Earlier Nostalgic sepia observation came from Special effects. First intended-Standard pair was tinted; explicit OK repeat passes. Exact installed image hash and recovery remain unverified; no measured speed gain.

entries.constraint: Cancel/return may persist other state; write failure is ignored by the existing UI. No callable general menu adapter.

entries.value: Seven-section policy, runtime erase geometry, protected-section predicates and bad-block paths mapped
entries.constraint: User-area backup relocates data by erasing/programming flash. Installed physical ranges and a passive host backup/recovery route remain unknown.

entries.constraint: Only current PTP-exposed objects; no installed flash, ROM, calibration/settings or raw SD-sector acquisition. Strict StorageInfo string parsing failed and is preserved.
